video.description:
Learn to explain how SwiftData macros turn Swift classes into saved data: @Model, @Transient & Index Macro, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
@Model - A macro that makes a Swift class something SwiftData can save and load.
@Transient - A macro that keeps a property out of the database, so SwiftData does not save it.
Index Macro - A macro that builds a fast lookup list for a property, so searches finish sooner.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain @Model, @Transient & Index Macro in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
@Model, @Transient, Index Macro 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

@Model - A macro that makes a Swift class something SwiftData can save and load.
한국어: @Model: Swift 클래스를 SwiftData가 저장하고 불러올 수 있게 만드는 매크로

@Transient - A macro that keeps a property out of the database, so SwiftData does not save it.
한국어: @Transient: 프로퍼티를 데이터베이스에 넣지 않아 SwiftData가 저장하지 않게 하는 매크로

Index Macro - A macro that builds a fast lookup list for a property, so searches finish sooner.
한국어: Index Macro: 프로퍼티의 빠른 조회 목록을 만들어 검색이 더 빨리 끝나게 하는 매크로

landscape.hook: Can you explain @Model, @Transient and Index Macro in English?

dialogue.title: What should be saved?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, how do I make `Note` a SwiftData class?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put @Model above the class. The macro does the rest.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, by default. But some properties should not be saved.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `isOpen`? It only says if the row is expanded.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Mark it @Transient, and SwiftData skips it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, I saved it by mistake, and the old rows had a strange value.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add @Transient and run the app again. It will fix that.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add an index macro, like `#Index` in our code. It builds a fast lookup for `title`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the index macro change what is saved?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. It only makes searches faster. Keep @Model on the class.
Add @Model above the class and it is ready to save.
